autoContext: Validates loadContext action. Covers: file param (path to JSON file), merge=True behaviour (all keys unpack directly into workflow context), key availability in subsequent steps via includedData, and graceful failure when file is missing.

load_valid._comment: PARAM: file — path to a JSON object file. All top-level keys merge into workflow context.

verify_keys._comment: Confirms test_string was loaded and is available via includedData.
Confirms test_number was loaded and is available via includedData.
Confirms test_multiline was loaded (multi-line values are preserved as strings).

load_missing._comment: PARAM: file pointing to nonexistent path — handler must return None gracefully, not crash.
Workflow continues even after a failed loadContext.
